description: We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) to lead a premier skilled nursing facility in Baltimore County, MD. This is a confidential opportunity for a visionary leader passionate about delivering exceptional patient care and operational excellence. Join a team committed to fostering a supportive environment for both residents and staff.As the LNHA, you will be responsible for the overall management and success of the facility, ensuring compliance with all state and federal regulations while upholding the highest standards of quality care. This pivotal role offers a competitive salary range of $115,000 to $145,000 per year, reflecting your expertise and contributions. We are looking for a leader who can inspire staff, optimize operations, and drive positive outcomes for our residents.
requirements: Active Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) license in Maryland
Proven experience in a skilled nursing facility or long-term care setting
Strong understanding of state and federal regulations (e.g., CMS, OBRA)
Demonstrated leadership and operational management skills
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation ranges from $115,000 to $145,000 annually, based on experience and qualifications.

description:
We are urgently seeking a dedicated Physical Therapist (PT) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Marianna, FL. This is an exceptional opportunity to make a significant impact on patients' lives, helping them regain mobility and improve their overall quality of life within a supportive and dynamic environment. Your expertise will be crucial in developing and implementing personalized treatment plans.

This role offers a competitive hourly rate of $38.00 - $48.00, reflecting our commitment to attracting top talent. If you are a compassionate and skilled Physical Therapist looking for an immediate and rewarding opportunity, we encourage you to apply.
requirements: Current and valid Physical Therapist (PT) license in the state of Florida
Doctor of Physical Therapy (DPT) degree or equivalent
Experience in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting preferred
Strong clinical assessment and treatment planning skills
Ability to work effectively as part of a multidisciplinary team
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly rate of $38.00 - $48.00, based on experience.
